hookups.source: https://gastateparks.reserveamerica.com/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=GA&parkId=535300 (site details of all 31 'Campsite Electric' sites: 'Electricity Hookup: 50/30' or '50' at 20 sites, '30' at 11; 'Water Hookup: Y' at all; no sewer listed); https://gastateparks.org/sites/default/files/parks/pdf/trailmaps/parkmaps/dames-ferry-sitemap.jpg ('30/50 Amp Pull-Thru', '30/50 Amp Site', '30 Amp Site'), read 2026-10-29

values.note: The park lists 30 tent/trailer/RV sites; the booking site has 31 electric sites (01-03, 08-26, 28, 29, 31-37), 01 and 02 marked Host. Per-site max vehicle length 20-50 ft: site 03 is 20 ft, 25, 26 and 31 give no length, the other 27 take a 23-ft rig. Pull-throughs: 10, 11, 12, 17, 29, 35 (and the two host sites).

sites.source: https://gastateparks.org/DamesFerry ('30 Tent, Trailer & RV Campsites'); https://gastateparks.reserveamerica.com/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=GA&parkId=535300 (every site's Max Vehicle Length / Driveway Entry), read 2026-10-29

facilities.source: https://gastateparks.org/sites/default/files/parks/pdf/trailmaps/parkmaps/dames-ferry-sitemap.jpg (Shower, Laundry and Restrooms symbols at the comfort station; Dump Station by the entrance), read 2026-10-29

booking.source: https://gastateparks.org/DamesFerry ('Make a Reservation' -> Georgia State Parks' ReserveAmerica site, parkId 535300; 'Reservations 800-864-7275'), read 2026-10-29

values.note: $36 a night at the back-in sites 31-37, $40 at the others (electric and water), the same on a weekday, a Saturday and in November 2026. The park page lists '$5 parking' rather than the $10 ParkPass. Read 2026-10-29.

fees.source: https://gastateparks.reserveamerica.com/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=GA&parkId=535300 (1-night prices for every site on 2027-06-15: $36.00 at 31-37, $40.00 elsewhere; sites 32 and 08 also on 2027-06-19 and 2026-11-10, unchanged); https://gastateparks.org/DamesFerry ('Fees & Passes: $5 parking'), read 2026-10-29

summary: Confirmed as a Georgia State Parks campground ('Operated by High Falls State Park') on gastateparks.org + ReserveAmerica + the 2022 site map: 30 sites listed (31 in the engine), 30/50 A + water, no sewer, lengths 20-50 ft (27 known to take 23 ft), pull-throughs; showers, laundry, dump; $36 (sites 31-37) / $40, weekday = Saturday = November. AWH note kept. Phone missing, website lacks the park page, ParkPass differs (flags).
